text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day Maruzensky and I finally begin training for her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or that was our plan, at least…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky, is it true that preparations for your debut race are in full swing?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You've already been given the nickname "Hot Rod." Are you confident you can back up such a title?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haha, well… I appreciate all of the attention, but I'd like to focus on training for now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I don't want to keep my trainer waiting, so I'll have to end the interview here. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I don't want to keep my trainer waiting, so I'll have to end the interview here. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Aw, can't you tell us anything more?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Charlie! You'll just have to wait!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Well, this Twinkle Series sure is shaping up to be very interesting!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: It sure is! But… who's "Charlie"?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew… Those reporters came out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fact that they're so interested in Maruzensky before she's even debuted shows how high expectations are of her.
choice_data_list: They're expecting big things from you.
They're expecting big things from you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, then I'd better try my best to meet those expectations.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All righty then, let's start with a 1,200-meter run to see where I stand for my debut race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm so hyped up today, I think I might set a new record for myself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The talent is clearly there, but…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The wind feels so good… Okay, I'm going to shift into higher gear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Above all else, the most charming thing about her is just how much she enjoys running!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Teehee, time really does fly when you're having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer, shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, Trainer, shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Great running, Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You looked super cool out there today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, my gosh! Thanks, you guys! I'm so happy you think I'm cool!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um… Could we maybe… practice together sometime? I wanna run super fast, like you!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: My dream is to win in the Classics! With your help, I'm sure I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: And I want to win the Arima Kinen! So please run with me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: How could I say no to such cute little athletes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Absitively posolutely! Let's all run together next time!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! See you then! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hooray! But what does "absitively posolutely" mean?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! To be young is a great thing.
choice_data_list: The newer students really look up to you.
The newer students really look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And I'm so grateful. Their support pushes me to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And yet… they have such big dreams about the Classics and the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Do you think I should aim for something like that too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must be talking about the need to set clear goals for herself…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aim high?
choice_data_list: It would be fun to run in the biggest races, don't you think?
It would be fun to run in the biggest races, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Fun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You really are something else, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You really are something else, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Most people would talk about winning, but you focus on how fun the races will be. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, you've convinced me! After my debut, let's aim for the big ones!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey, artichokey!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't we have something sweet to commemorate our new beginning?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know all the hip places! It'll be my treat!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm… Doesn't it look delicious? This stuff is mega huge with trendy people, you know!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yum, orange smoothie! Enjoy! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's just starting to catch on, so there aren't many stores that serve it!
choice_data_list: Couldn't that mean it's just… not popular?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're so behind the times, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're so behind the times, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always follow the latest happenings, so I know what's hot and what's not!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, c'mon, drink up! It's a new flavor sensation that'll make you weep with joy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Maruzensky, with her brilliant racing instincts—and questionable trend knowledge—begins her next challenge!
